title: ProtScape: A molecular structure and energy-aware representation for protein conformation generation
abstract: arXiv:2410.20317v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Molecular dynamics (MD) simulations are a principled but computationally expensive approach for studying protein conformational variability, making it challenging to generate large ensembles of structures or characterize transitions between metastable conformations. AI methods for upsampling MD simulations have been developed recently but struggle due to difficulties of sampling complex, high-dimensional molecular distributions. One avenue these methods overlook is to learn a latent space where such sampling becomes easier. To address this, we introduce ProtScape, a generative geometric deep learning framework that learns structure and energy-aware representations of protein conformational landscapes from MD simulations. ProtScape represents protein conformations using an equivariant graph neural network and a multiscale deep wavelet transform that captures local geometric interactions and nonlocal collective motions. translated_title: ProtScape：一种用于蛋白质构象生成的分子结构与能量感知表示
translated_abstract: 分子动力学（MD）模拟是研究蛋白质构象变化的一种有理论依据但计算代价高昂的方法，这使得生成大规模的结构集合或刻画亚稳态构象之间的转变变得极具挑战性。近年来，一些用于对MD模拟进行上采样的AI方法已被开发出来，但由于难以采样复杂、高维的分子分布，这些方法表现不佳。这些方法忽视了一条路径，即学习一个使此类采样变得更容易的潜在空间。为解决这一问题，我们提出了ProtScape——一个生成式几何深度学习框架，它能够从MD模拟中学习蛋白质构象景观的结构与能量感知表示。ProtScape采用等变图神经网络与多尺度深度小波变换来表示蛋白质构象，从而捕捉局部几何相互作用以及非局域的集体运动。这一潜在表示……
tldr: ProtScape是一个生成式几何深度学习框架，通过等变图神经网络和多尺度深度小波变换，从分子动力学模拟中学习蛋白质构象景观的结构与能量感知潜在表示，从而简化复杂高维分子分布的采样难题。
en_tdlr: ProtScape is a generative geometric deep learning framework that learns structure- and energy-aware latent representations of protein conformational landscapes from MD simulations using an equivariant graph neural network and a multiscale deep wavelet transform, making the sampling of complex, high-dimensional molecular distributions easier.
